purpose: 在同一张图中先导出、替换 mid 上游、再次导出，观察全部有效分支及脱离分支的登记状态。
output:
ExportUpstreamLineage("report") ->
{"nodes":["a","b","c","mid","old","oldroot","raw","report"],"edges":[{"from":"a","to":"mid"},{"from":"b","to":"c"},{"from":"c","to":"mid"},{"from":"mid","to":"report"},{"from":"old","to":"mid"},{"from":"oldroot","to":"old"},{"from":"raw","to":"a"},{"from":"raw","to":"b"},{"from":"raw","to":"mid"}]}
Register("mid", ["a" "c"]) -> <nil>
ExportUpstreamLineage("report") ->
{"nodes":["a","b","c","mid","raw","report"],"edges":[{"from":"a","to":"mid"},{"from":"b","to":"c"},{"from":"c","to":"mid"},{"from":"mid","to":"report"},{"from":"raw","to":"a"},{"from":"raw","to":"b"}]}
raw parents=[] children=[a b]
mid parents=[a c] children=[report]
report parents=[mid] children=[view]
old parents=[oldroot] children=[]
oldroot parents=[] children=[old]
